title: DatabasePoolConfigurationSchema
description: Validation schema for database connection URL parameters and environment options

DATABASE_URL.description: Transaction pooler connection URL (Supabase PgBouncer on port 6543) containing pgbouncer=true, connection_limit, and pool_timeout

DIRECT_URL.description: Direct PostgreSQL connection URL (port 5432) reserved exclusively for Prisma schema migrations

DB_CONNECTION_LIMIT.description: Fallback connection pool size per API instance if not embedded in DATABASE_URL

DB_POOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Seconds to queue requests before failing with HTTP 503 when pool is saturated

DB_TX_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Maximum execution duration for interactive Prisma transactions
